otherObject.description: Locator of the other data source to join with.

otherDataset.description: Optional locator (id, name) of the other data source dataset (if Custom Object) to join with.

selectFields.description: List of fields to select. Must be prefixed with 'aoc.' for Act-On Contacts fields or 'co.' for custom object fields. Use 'aoc.*' or 'co.*' to select all fields from respective source.

page.description: Page number (0-based). DEPRECATED: Use pagination object instead.

size.description: Number of items per page. DEPRECATED: Use pagination object instead.

pagination.description: Pagination information supporting both offset and cursor-based pagination

sortBy.description: Sort by field. Reference Act-On Contacts fields by the prefix `aoc.` if they overlap with custom object fields. DEPRECATED: Use sortFields instead for multiple field sorting.

sortByDirection.description: Sort direction. Either `asc` or `desc`. If anything else no sorting will be applied. DEPRECATED: Use sortFields instead for multiple field sorting.

sortFields.description: List of fields to sort by with their directions. Takes precedence over sortBy/sortByDirection. Each field must be prefixed with 'aoc.' for Act-On Contacts fields or 'co.' for custom object fields.

datetimeFieldsTimezone.description: Override timezone for all DATETIME fields in the query. Must be a valid timezone identifier (e.g., 'US/Eastern', 'Europe/London', 'UTC'). If specified, this overrides both account-level and field-level timezone settings.

JoinStrategyDTO.description: Configuration for join operations between Act-On Contacts and Custom Objects

useDefaults.description: When set to true, other parameters are ignored and the defaults are used based on the relationship type of the custom object. Defaults to false

joinEnabled.description: Enable or disable join with other data. Defaults to true

onlyMatching.description: If true, only matching records will be joined. Defaults to false

duplicates.description: Strategy for handling duplicates. If not provided, defaults to 'noJoinFieldsDuplicates for Custom Objects with 'one-to-one' relationship and 'noActOnContactsJoinFieldsDuplicates' for 'one-to-many' relationship

otherOrderByField.description: Field name to order joined data by. If not provided, defaults to 'updatedDate'

otherSelector.description: Selection strategy for joined data when duplicates exist. If not provided, defaults to 'last'

baseOrderByField.description: Field name to order base data by. If not provided, defaults to 'sys.createdAt'

baseSelector.description: Selection strategy for the base data when duplicates exist. If not provided, defaults to 'last'

PaginationDTO.description: Pagination information for data query requests

nextPageToken.description: Token for cursor-based pagination. Use null or omit for the first page.

pageStrategy.description: Pagination strategy to use. Defaults to OFFSET if not specified.

field.description: Field name to sort by. Must be prefixed with 'aoc.' for Act-On Contacts fields or 'co.' for custom object fields.
